intro.value: The town campsite of Blönduós, in Brautarhvammur right by Route 1 (the Ring Road): coming from the south, it is on the right immediately after you cross the bridge over the river Blanda heading north. The site is fairly flat and grassy, sheltered in its upper part, and watched by security cameras. A service house has toilets (including an accessible toilet), hot and cold water and dishwashing facilities, and there are electric hook-ups. The campsite belongs to the municipality of Húnabyggð, which leased its town campsites to L&E ehf. on a short-term contract until the end of October 2026, and which has decided to move the campsite to a new location (see below).

season.value: Published 2026 season: 1 January – 30 October on tjalda.is, 1 March – 30 October on Parka.is. Both listings also carry an 'Open all year' tag, which contradicts their own dates. Ferdalag.is has no separate listing for this campsite.
season.note: Source conflict: tjalda.is and Parka.is give different start dates (1 January vs 1 March) for the same operator, and both show an 'Open all year' tag next to a season ending 30 October.

winter.value: Closed in winter (treat as closed for winter 2026–27). Both published seasons end on 30 October (tjalda.is and Parka.is), Húnabyggð's signed short-term lease of its town campsites ran only until the end of October 2026, and Blönduós is not on ferdalag.is's camper winter service list (checked 2026-11-22). The 'Open all year' tags on tjalda.is and Parka.is contradict the dates on the same listings and no source gives winter services, so do not plan a November–March night here without contacting the campsite first (+354 837 1300). The Glaðheimar cottages next to the campsite are listed as open all year, but that listing describes the cottages. Going north, Hamrar in Akureyri is on the official winter list.

electricity.value: Yes – electric hook-ups, 1,500 ISK per night (tjalda.is, Parka.is; the municipality's directory also lists electricity). Number of hook-ups, amperage and socket type are not published; a 2020 municipal notice said there were sockets 'in several places'.

kitchen.note: No campers' kitchen is listed. Tjalda.is, Parka.is and the municipality list dishwashing facilities only.

showers.value: Yes – toilets and showers are included in the price (tjalda.is 'Rates 2026'); Parka.is tags a shower. Tjalda.is's own service tags list toilets but not showers.

toilets.value: Yes – toilets in the service house, including a toilet for disabled guests (tjalda.is, municipality).

dump_station.value: Yes – tjalda.is says waste disposal for mobile homes is included in the price (the Icelandic text: a facility to empty the water from motorhomes), and Parka.is tags 'Seyrulosun' (sludge disposal) and water refill. Exact location and whether cassette toilets can be emptied there are not published.

wifi.note: Wi-Fi is not mentioned by tjalda.is, Parka.is or the municipality.

laundry.note: Current listings do not mention a washing machine. Húnabyggð's 2020 notice seeking an operator listed a washing machine in the service house, but that is out of date and no fee is published.

camping_card.note: The Camping Card (Útilegukortið) website did not respond on 2026-11-22, so we could not check its 2026 list. Tjalda.is and Parka.is do not mention the card.

practical.value: The campsite is moving. On 27 November 2025 Húnabyggð's council confirmed its intention to move the Blönduós campsite to a new location, and approved a plan change that turns area 2 of Brautarhvammur, previously for motorhomes and caravans, into plots for five guesthouses and a service house. A new campsite at Hnjúkabyggð is being planned (plan description dated 18 September 2026). Check which site is operating before a 2027 visit.

In summer 2026 the same operator also ran a temporary campsite at Hnjúkabyggð in Blönduós (10 July – 30 September): toilets and electricity (8 hook-ups in each of areas A and B), no showers yet (guests are referred to the town pool); 2026 rates adults 1,500 ISK, children free, electricity 1,500 ISK, lodging tax 400 ISK. The municipality got a permit for a 20-foot container as toilets at its planned campsite.

Booking: tjalda.is shows the campsite as taking both drop-in and pre-booked guests and links to Parka.is for reservations, but Parka.is says online booking for this campsite has not been activated. Expect to turn up and pay on site, or phone ahead.
Blönduós swimming pool (Sundlaugin Blönduósi, Melabraut 2, +354 455 4780) is listed as open all year; opening hours and prices are on imb.is.

East of Blönduós, Route 1 crosses the Vatnsskarð pass towards Varmahlíð, one of the Ring Road mountain passes prone to closure. Check road conditions on umferdin.is or call the traffic service on 1777 before driving.
